minutes.headline: Planning Board approved the 270 Electric Avenue site plan, with set construction hours and a West Street entrance limit
minutes.summary: The board closed the public hearing on the 270 Electric Avenue application after members asked about tree clearing, the tower fall zone, and the stormwater permit acreage. It then approved the plan with added conditions on construction hours, compliance with other town boards' approvals, and limiting the West Street entrance. This was the only agenda item, and the meeting then adjourned.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board closed the public hearing on the 270 Electric Avenue application after questions on tree clearing, the tower fall zone and the stormwater filing.

The applicant's stormwater (NPDES) filing and the statement of site acreage were set to be followed up on.
